title: add benchmark-lab profiling baselines, representative runners, and reporting pipeline v18
author: Priya Singh
description:
Motivation: bring profiling baselines and representative workload runners up-to-date for the new seq-len and kv-cache optimizations; centralize reporting to the benchmark-lab pipeline v18. This PR adds: 1) profiling baselines for 8/16/32k context models (float16/int8 quantization profiles), 2) new representative workload runners that exercise streaming, tiled-attention, and KV-cache reuse patterns, 3) a unified reporting pipeline that aggregates performance, allocation, and eval-quality metrics into BigQuery and S3, and 4) documentation and example configs for Dedicated runs. Checklist: - [x] Add profiling baselines and scripts - [x] Implement runner harness + example workload manifests - [x] Integrate reporting pipeline (airflow DAG + CI config) - [x] Add unit/integration tests and perf smoke checks - [x] Documentation and quickstart updates Related: Linear ENG-1987, ENG-2005. Notes: the reporting pipeline is backwards-compatible with v17 datasets; ingestion stage supports both old and new column schemas. This is intentionally scoped to the benchmark-lab repo and the redwood-model-registry example templates 
 infra changes for Dedicated autoscaling will be follow-up (ENG-2029).
commits: initial: add profiling baselines for 8k/16k/32k seq-len test vectors

tests: add perf smoke tests and CI gating for reporting pipeline
